purpose: Evidence-backed strategic opportunity backlog. Execute one bounded growth experiment at a time; technical and attribution repairs may supersede the lock.
currentConstraint: Relevant organic traffic is still the binding constraint. Only 1 Google click reached content pages outside the home page and /app/ during the latest 30-day GSC window, so conversion optimization must remain sample-gated.

opportunities.thesis: Turn the existing first-year-cost calculator into the center of the page so visitors compare total 12-month cost by consumption before choosing a partner, instead of consuming another generic top-list.

evidence.marketPattern: Leading Swedish results increasingly compare total cost across household consumption levels and distinguish fixed fee, markup and campaign period.

guardrails: existing URL only
no unsupported 'cheapest' claim
user inputs determine comparison context
keep affiliate disclosure visible
successSignal: higher qualified organic CTR/ranking over time
more partner impressions and verified affiliate clicks from the page
eventual approved revenue per relevant visitor

opportunities.thesis: Add a compact 'Passar kvartspris mig?' decision utility to satisfy the explanatory query first and then bridge suitable users to relevant electricity comparison options.

gsc: vad menas med kvartspris på el: 28 impressions, position 9.1, 0 clicks
evidence.marketPattern: Search demand mixes explanation with decision support; a useful calculator/check beats multiplying keyword-variant pages.

guardrails: answer the informational intent before commercial CTA
no claim that quarter-hour pricing always saves money
one useful page, no fan-out pages
successSignal: CTR improvement on top-10 explanatory query
more organic sessions reaching relevant electricity partner options

opportunities.target: existing pages with repeated top-10 low-CTR queries
opportunities.thesis: On a young site, waiting for 80 impressions can slow learning too much. Permit one controlled snippet test when a query has at least 25 impressions, top-10 average position, near-zero CTR and appears on at least four distinct days.

gsc: jämför försäkring qualified at 31 impressions and position 7.6 and is the active experiment
vad menas med kvartspris på el is the next likely candidate at 28 impressions and position 9.1
evidence.rationale: Small but repeated top-10 exposure is enough to test metadata without rewriting body content.

guardrails: one active experiment only
metadata-only unless a utility gap is independently proven
minimum post-change sample before verdict

opportunities.thesis: Differentiate from generic insurance text with a practical collective-bostadsrättstillägg checklist and decision path into the existing protection check, while keeping claims conservative.

evidence.marketPattern: Current results combine concrete coverage details, deductible ranges and clear purchase paths; trust and precision matter more than affiliate density.

guardrails: no fabricated prices or coverage facts
source time-sensitive claims
do not imply individualized insurance advice

opportunities.target: contextual links from ranking content into /app/
opportunities.thesis: Kostnadskollen is already the strongest Google landing page. Once content pages receive enough real organic visits, test one context-specific path into the app rather than redesigning the whole funnel.

ga4: current app event sample is too small and recently instrumented for a broad CRO conclusion

guardrails: do not infer funnel rates from pre-instrumentation periods
use organic cohort only
one CTA placement test at a time

opportunities.thesis: When enough verified clicks and approved transactions exist, optimize ordering only among partners that are equally relevant to the user's intent, using approved revenue per click with an exploration floor.

evidence.current: No approved transactions yet; 104 Adtraction clicks include legacy/testing traffic and cannot support routing decisions.
evidence.rollout: Post-attribution rollout currently has only 3 Adtraction clicks; 2 carry local EPI, so commercial learning is not mature.

guardrails: user relevance outranks commission
require healthy attribution
minimum 50 verified clicks and 5 approved transactions before testing
never hide clearly better user-fit options for payout
